feedback: Accepted. The RM is well-formed and faithful to the task 'Get into the locked room. Pick up the ball.' Checks: (1) Format is the exact ARM-FM paper layout: STATES/INITIAL_STATE/FINAL_STATES headers, TRANSITION_FUNCTION as (state, event) -> state, REWARD_FUNCTION as (state, event, state') -> reward. FINAL_STATES is nonempty (u5), u5 is declared in STATES, and it is the accepting goal state reached on target_picked_up, which is the episode-terminating event. (2) Ordered transition coverage matches the card's constraint chain exactly: key_found -> has_matching_key -> target_door_open -> target_room_entered -> target_picked_up, with no skipped or reordered milestones; the two prerequisites (key, key-in-hand) are legitimately included as necessary subgoals and give the chain denser progress signals. (3) Every state has an else self-loop, so all irrelevant events (turns, moves, opening unrelated doors, other propositions) fall through harmlessly; events are predicate-only over the five propositions with & and !. (4) Persistent/event handling is correct: the RM relies on the labeler's latches for key_found and target_room_entered, so at u1 the clause has_matching_key still matches on the pickup step even though key_found is also true; u5 self-loops and the episode ends at the pickup, so the last-step-only nature of target_picked_up causes no issue. (5) Reward safety: all rewards non-negative, only on forward transitions, terminal-dominant (1.0), bounded total 1.65, zero on self-loops, and the combined u0->u2 reward (0.15) equals the split-path total (0.05+0.1), so no path is over- or under-paid. Monotone design correctly prevents reward farming: re-picking up a dropped key at u2 or re-opening the door at u3 falls to the else self-loop with no reward; the card's regressing conditions (has_matching_key, target_door_open can turn false, e.g. the required drop of the key before the ball pickup) are handled by else self-loops, and this monotone sequence task does not require explicit back-transitions. (6) Co-occurrence edge cases check out: target_room_entered strictly precedes target_picked_up by at least one step (the agent must move onto the doorway/inside cell before a pickup action), so the u3->u4->u5 chain cannot skip the final reward; target_door_open co-occurring with has_matching_key at u2 is handled by the target_door_open clause. Minor note, not a defect: the defensive clause (u0, key_found & has_matching_key) -> u2 is unreachable in practice, since key_found must latch at an earlier labeled step than the pickup (the key leaves the view once carried, and the card guarantees has_matching_key never precedes key_found); it is harmless and keeps the combined-path reward consistent, and the u0 else branch would even let a hypothetical constraint-violating run recover once the key is dropped and seen. All states u0-u5 are reachable and the goal is reachable from u0.
